slips.note: Extra slip you asked for (both legs rated low): won. Juventus 2-0 Leuven, Chelsea 1-0 PSG.

legs.event: Juventus FC vs. Oud-Heverlee Leuven Women
legs.label: To win
legs.reason: Fixture verified: Juventus vs OH Leuven, UEFA Women's Champions League 2026/27 matchday 5, 18 Nov, 21:00 Madrid time which is 20:00 UTC. Juventus are the clear favourite on form and league position, but I cut p below the Polymarket price because the bookmaker price (about 68-71%) is well under 79%, line-ups were not out, and Juventus lost 0-6 to Lyon on 11 Nov and played Inter on 15 Nov. Leuven's defence is weak, but Juventus can slip to a draw.
legs.main_risk: A draw or upset against a low-ranked side, with possible rotation after the Inter game on 15 Nov. Line-ups unconfirmed, the venue sources conflict, and the market price is 8-10 points above the bookmaker price.

checks.team_news: No injury or suspension news found for either side. The Juventus pre-match press conference and Leuven news did not surface. Coaches per UEFA.com: Isaac Guerrero (Juventus), Ster Habibzadeh (Leuven). No coach change found.
checks.lineups: Official line-ups NOT found. Searches of the UEFA.com line-ups page returned squad lists only, and nothing from Juventus, OHL, Flashscore or Sofascore. Key facts missing.
checks.rotation: Juventus played Lyon on 11 Nov (0-6 loss) and then won 2-3 away at Inter on 15 Nov per Futboltotal, so they have 3 days of rest and a domestic game in between. Leuven drew 1-1 with Koge on 11 Nov and lost 1-5 to Servette on 28 Oct. Rotation risk is unverified.
checks.motivation: League phase matchday 5. After the Lyon loss Juventus are 8th on 6 points (UEFA.com/Goal snippet). Leuven are 17th by the brief's Goal snippet, which I could not re-verify. The full 2026/27 table was not found. Neither side looks qualified or eliminated, and nothing suggests the favourite has nothing to play for, so no hard exclusion.
checks.form: Juventus last five per Futboltotal: 4 wins, 1 loss (0-6 vs Lyon, then 2-3 at Inter). Leuven last five: 1 win, 2 draws, 2 losses, including the 1-5 loss to Servette and the 1-1 draw with Koge. Leuven keeper Seynhaeve has conceded 14 in 8 games. Juventus keeper de Jong has conceded 11 in 7.
checks.h2h: No earlier meeting this season found. Futboltotal shows none, and a 22 Sep listing in search results looks like a bad date. Leuven's other 2026/27 results show a weak defence.
checks.odds: WinComparator (brief, possibly stale): Juventus 1.40 / draw 4.50 / Leuven 5.75, about 68-71% Juventus after de-vig. Polymarket live is 0.794 / 0.133 / 0.074, so the market is about 8-10 points ABOVE the bookmaker figure. I could not check the 24h move or the Polymarket volume, and found no second fresh price.
checks.models: No bookmaker-free rating (ClubElo does not cover women's football) and no model prediction found.
checks.venue_weather: Juventus announced the game will be played at Stadio Pozzo-La Marmora, Biella, instead of the originally indicated ground. The club said the move protects the Allianz Stadium pitch, and the home side still plays in its own region, so this is not an exclusion. Futboltotal lists Juventus Center, Turin, instead, so the venue sources conflict. Weather not checked.

legs.event: Chelsea FC vs. Paris Saint-Germain FC
legs.label: To win
legs.reason: Chelsea are clear home favourites: unbeaten, no goals conceded, top of the WSL, against a PSG side that is 10th and has injuries. I keep confidence low because official line-ups were not found, key attackers (James, Malard) are out, a bookmaker price implies about 0.675 against Polymarket 0.745, and Chelsea's games are low-scoring (two 0-0 draws).
legs.main_risk: A draw: Chelsea have scored 3 goals in 4 league-phase games and drew 0-0 twice, and PSG may be content with a point. Unconfirmed line-ups are a further risk.

checks.team_news: Chelsea out: Girma, Lauren James (hamstring), Matsukubo, Ramirez (personal), Malard (injured); Buchanan also forced off injured at the weekend (Livescore, StatsZone, Mightytips). PSG out: Karchaoui, Ebayilin, Ajibade, Leuchter (StatsZone); Livescore lists no PSG injuries, so the sources disagree.
checks.lineups: Official line-ups NOT found (searches and previews all pre-date them; UEFA/club X/Flashscore not retrievable). Predicted Chelsea XI per StatsZone is 3-4-3: Peng; Bronze, Bjorn, Buurman; Carpenter, Walsh, Potter, Baltimore; Kaptein, Beever-Jones, Nusken. Livescore has Hampton in goal and a back four, so the two sources differ. Predicted PSG XI: Kiedrzynek; Chagas/Isabela, Mbock, Dudek/Samoura, Carmona; Osteras; Kanjinga, Groenen, Echegini; Lafontaine/Jourde. Unconfirmed.
checks.rotation: Chelsea played Saturday (1-0 v Man City in the WSL, which put them top), after a 0-0 at Hacken on 10 Nov. PSG beat Marseille 2-0 in the league on Saturday. No sign of heavy rotation, but nothing is confirmed.
checks.motivation: Matchday 5 of 6. Chelsea are 5th on 8 points after two wins and two 0-0 draws, with no goals conceded, and are chasing a top-8 finish and a bye. PSG are 10th on 5 points (W5-0 v Leuven, D1-1 Madrid, D1-1 Man City, L1-2 Bayern) and need a result to stay in the playoff places. Neither side has nothing to play for, so the hard motivation rule does not apply.
checks.form: Chelsea are unbeaten this season. League phase: W1-0 Austria Wien, D0-0 Lyon, W Roma (listed as 2-0, one source unclear), D0-0 Hacken. They have scored only 3 goals in 4 games and conceded 0. PSG have scored 8 in 4 games but lost 1-2 at home to Bayern.
checks.h2h: Chelsea won both 2022-23 group games (1-0 in Paris, 3-0 at home). The Oct 2025 meeting was in the league phase, but I did not get its score. Chelsea's low-scoring, tight games make a draw or a narrow win more likely than the market suggests.
checks.odds: Melbet (via Mightytips, 16 Nov): Chelsea 1.36, draw 5.00, PSG 6.50. De-vigged that is about 0.675 / 0.184 / 0.141, so 7 points below Polymarket's 0.745 for Chelsea. Over 2.5 is 1.40 and under 2.5 is 2.87, which gives over about 0.67, in line with the market. Forebet gives Chelsea 63%. Polymarket Chelsea price rose from 0.71 to 0.745 in 24h (+4.9%, a firming of the favourite, not a fall). I did not check market volume. No Stake or Rainbet price seen.
checks.models: No Elo or Opta rating found. Forebet gives Chelsea 63%, Livescore predicts 3-1 Chelsea, StatsZone predicts under 2.5 goals, Mightytips predicts BTTS.
checks.venue_weather: Cherry Red Records Stadium (Kingsmeadow), Wimbledon, London, Chelsea's normal home ground (Livescore, Mightytips). One preview names Wheatsheaf Park, which looks wrong. Weather not checked.

legs.label: To win (moneyline, overtime counts)
legs.reason: Hawks are the better team (9-6 vs 4-10), have no back-to-back, and have rest and a large injury edge. The Hornets are missing Knueppel, Schroder, Allen and Williams, and the Hawks won the first meeting by 47. DraftKings and Polymarket agree at about 0.67-0.70 and the price did not move against the favourite. I set p_fav slightly below the market (0.67) to reflect the no-vig DK number and the Hawks' own injuries.
legs.main_risk: The Hawks are without McCollum and Landale with Flemings day-to-day, and the injury data is from ESPN only (official NBA report not verified). A -7.5 spread is large for a team on a 3-game road swing of rest and a possible letdown, and Hornets +7.5 is a close market on Polymarket. The home/away listing also conflicts with the brief.

checks.Injuries: Source is ESPN game summary injuries, not the official NBA PDF, which I did not open. Hawks: CJ McCollum out (calf, return around 19 Dec), Jock Landale out (hip, return 22 Nov), Asa Newell out, Mouhamed Gueye out, Kingston Flemings day-to-day (back strain, listed 19 Nov, return date 20 Nov). Jalen Johnson and Nickeil Alexander-Walker (the two Hawks leaders on the ESPN preview) are not on the list. Hornets: Kon Knueppel out (hamstring, to ~12 Dec), Dennis Schroder out (hamstring, to ~25 Nov), Grayson Allen out (concussion, to 23 Nov), Grant Williams out (hamstring, to 23 Nov). No star rest or load management found for either team.
checks.Rest: Hawks last played Wed 18 Nov at OKC (W 117-112), so no back-to-back and about 2 days of rest. Hornets last played 17 Nov at LAL (L 118-114 OT), about 3 days of rest, with a road trip PHX/LAC/LAL before this game. Neither team is on a back-to-back.
checks.form: ESPN records: Hawks 9-6 (8-2 road, 3-3 home); Hornets 4-10 (1-6 road). Hawks last 5: W BKN, L LAL, L at CHI (OT), W at MIL, W at OKC. Hornets last 5: L BOS 119-80, W CLE, L at PHX, L at LAC, L at LAL (OT), so 1-4. Season series so far: Hawks beat Hornets 128-81 on 23 Oct. I did not pull net ratings.
checks.odds: DraftKings via ESPN: ATL -7.5 (-108), total 218.5, moneyline ATL -249 / CHA +205. That is about 71% implied with vig and about 67-68% without. Polymarket moneyline is Hawks 0.695 / Hornets 0.305, and the ATL -7.5 spread market is about 0.50, which agrees with DK. The Hornets moneyline price moved -0.07 over 24h (Hawks up 0.07). The move is consistent with the 19 Nov Hornets injury additions (Allen, Williams) and not against the favourite, so I found no adverse movement.
checks.Matchup: No upset angle found. The Hornets are badly short-handed (4 rotation players out) and were blown out by ATL 128-81 earlier this season. The only spot risk is Hawks looking past a weak team, plus Flemings' status and McCollum/Landale being out. Discrepancy: ESPN lists ATL as the home team at State Farm Arena (CHA at ATL), while the task brief says the Hornets are home. The odds and the Polymarket spread both treat ATL as the favourite either way.
checks.Final check: Official NBA injury report 6:15 PM ET: Hawks out Flemings (lumbar strain, was day-to-day), Gueye, Castro (two-way); Jalen Johnson and Alexander-Walker not listed. Hornets out Allen, Knueppel, Schroder, Grant Williams. Polymarket Hawks 0.695 → 0.705 and DraftKings ATL moneyline -249 → -277, so the price moved toward the Hawks.

legs.label: To win (moneyline, overtime counts)
legs.reason: Detroit is clearly the better and healthier team: 10-4 against 5-10, Toronto on a 5-game losing streak with Leonard and Barrett out, and DK and Polymarket agree at about 0.71. Confidence is medium rather than high only because Cunningham is day-to-day and I could not confirm his status from the official report.
legs.main_risk: Duren (starting centre) is out, as he has been since 18 Nov, and Cunningham is probable with knee soreness, so a limited Cunningham is the main risk. A -6.5 spread leaves room for a close game.

checks.Injuries: ESPN game summary (pulled today): DET - Cade Cunningham day-to-day (soreness, listed 19 Nov, return date 20 Nov, so probably plays but NOT confirmed; I found no official NBA report or dated beat report to confirm), Ronald Holland II day-to-day (knee bruise, GTD), Ugonna Onyenso day-to-day, Taurean Prince out (surgery), Ebuka Okorie out. TOR - Kawhi Leonard OUT (inflammation, return about 3 Dec), RJ Barrett OUT (strain, about 13 Dec), Collin Murray-Boyles OUT, Nate Bittle OUT (fracture). Raptors are missing their two best players. I could not access the official.nba.com PDF; web search returned only old-season articles, so no star-rest/load-management news found for tonight.
checks.Rest: No back-to-back for DET: last games were at SA and at NO on consecutive days, then ESPN shows no game on 20 Nov, so a day off before tip, though it is a heavy week and a road game. TOR last played WSH (L 103-99) the night before the DET/TOR slate; dates in ESPN are UTC so exact rest days are approximate. Note ESPN lists DET as the HOME team (TOR away), contrary to the task's note that the Raptors are home.
checks.form: DET 10-4 (road 7-2, home 3-2); last 5: W vs WSH 122-111, W at WSH 144-140 2OT, L at MIA 137-117, W at SA 105-93, W at NO 122-109 (4-1). TOR 5-10 (home 2-6, road 3-4); last 5 all losses (BOS 98-93, at PHI 123-112, NY 112-108 OT, NY 111-102, WSH 103-99). Net rating not checked.
checks.odds: DraftKings via ESPN: DET -6.5 (spread odds -116), ML DET -264 / TOR +217, total 216.5. No-vig DK implied about 0.71 for DET (-264 = 0.725 raw; after vig about 0.70-0.71). Polymarket 0.715 is in line with DK, so no disagreement. ESPN gives only closing/current lines with no open-to-now history, so I cannot say whether the price moved today; the Cunningham GTD tag (not priced as a risk in the spread, as far as I can tell) is the only visible news.
checks.Matchup: No upset angle found. TOR is 5-10 on a 5-game losing streak and without Leonard and Barrett; DET is 10-4 with the better road record. Possible small upset factors: DET heavy travel/schedule spot and Cunningham's soreness; no rivalry or revenge angle found.
checks.Final check: Official NBA injury report 6:15 PM ET: Cade Cunningham PROBABLE (was questionable on 18 Nov). Jalen Duren out (hamstring; already out on the 18 Nov report, and Detroit won both games since). Ronald Holland II doubtful. Raptors out Leonard, Barrett, Murray-Boyles. Polymarket Pistons 0.715 → 0.705 (down 1.4%, under the 3% limit); DraftKings DET -264 unchanged.
